CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW premium_gaming_mice AS
SELECT 
    t1.devregistry AS device_registry,
    t1.makername AS manufacturer_name,
    t1.modnum AS model_number,
    t3.scraccy AS performance_score,
    t2.comfort AS comfort,
    CASE 
        WHEN t3.scraccy > 90 THEN 'High-End'
        ELSE 'Standard'
    END AS classification
FROM 
    deviceidentity AS t1
JOIN 
    physicaldurability AS t2 ON t1.devregistry = t2.physperfref
JOIN 
    performance AS t3 ON t2.physperfref = t3.perfregistry
WHERE 
    t1.senstype ILIKE '%mouse%'
LIMIT 10;
